title: Li Si Cin: Soviet Vietnam Campaign
display_name: Li Si Cin: Soviet Vietnam Campaign

runtime_selection.notes: Use with F15_REPLACEMENT_ROOT pointing at converted_assets_all. The scenario base limits WLD redirection to the intended source theater, and --campaign selects that base theater automatically in START.

launch.notes: Launchers can use this block directly; runtime_selection is the lower-level WLD redirect detail.

runtime_modes.title: Full campaign
runtime_modes.notes: Normal play mode. Loads campaign.json, redirects the base theater WLD, enables campaign-local media, and applies selected sortie briefing/targets.

runtime_modes.title: Full campaign, selected sortie
runtime_modes.notes: Use a sortie id such as carrier_strike, or a phase number such as 2.

runtime_modes.title: Raw custom WLD scenario
runtime_modes.notes: Testing mode for only the WLD JSON redirect. Use --campaign for the complete pack.

images.notes: Custom PNGs may use higher resolution and truecolor; runtime maps them into the legacy draw target instead of treating pixels as game-world size.

sounds.notes: Replace per-cue WAV files directly; the original digitized sound blob is not required for custom cue authoring.

fonts.notes: Use scalable Unicode fonts for localized campaign text where runtime text paths support TTF/OTF.

models.notes: Keep the shape slot prefix stable so WLD/object references still resolve to the edited model.

runtime_contract.notes: The pack is intentionally media-first and editable; original game data remains the fallback for behavior not represented by modern assets yet.

custom_world_scenario.notes: `--campaign SVN` selects the campaign wrapper; `--scenario SVN --scenario-base VN` tests only WLD redirection.

soviet_vietnam_campaign.theme: Soviet/Vietnamese side against USA air, naval, logistics, and air-defense targets

modern_png_images.notes: The complete room/person set supersedes WALL.png and split arm overlays in the OpenGL briefing renderer.

modern_wav_radio.generated_postprocess: local TTS WAVs are normalized to mono unsigned PCM8 radio cues when possible

modern_fonts.notes: Font files are campaign-local override points; generated packs copy a supplied font when --font is used, otherwise these paths document where customizers place Unicode fonts.

mission_objectives.name: Soviet forward HQ
success_criteria: HQ remains available as sortie staging point
mission_objectives.intent: Player staging area and campaign anchor for Lisicin / Li Si Cin.

mission_objectives.name: USA carrier group
success_criteria: primary ship or carrier-equivalent object destroyed
at least one escort/radar object suppressed if present
mission_objectives.suggested_loadout: anti-ship / heavy strike ordnance with fighter cover
mission_objectives.intent: Main naval strike target in the Gulf of Tonkin.

mission_objectives.name: Da Nang airbase
mission_objectives.desired_effect: reduce USA sortie tempo from the coastal airbase
success_criteria: secondary fuel/logistics object destroyed if placed
mission_objectives.suggested_loadout: runway cratering bombs plus self-defense missiles
mission_objectives.intent: Airbase strike target for runway, fuel, and aircraft concentration.

real_world_anchor.label: Da Nang airbase
real_world_anchor.doctrine: crater runway and burn fuel/parked-aircraft capacity

mission_objectives.name: Hanoi radar net

success_criteria: radar object destroyed or moved out of active route
SAM/AAA object destroyed if paired with the radar
mission_objectives.intent: SAM/radar suppression target protecting North Vietnam.

mission_objectives.name: Haiphong logistics
mission_objectives.desired_effect: slow USA resupply and coastal reinforcement
success_criteria: escape route remains open after attack
mission_objectives.suggested_loadout: medium bombs or rockets with fuel margin for egress
mission_objectives.intent: Depot, bridge, port, or logistics interdiction target.

mission_objectives.name: Tonkin patrol
mission_objectives.desired_effect: draw USA fighters away from the carrier strike lane
success_criteria: enemy patrol aircraft destroyed or displaced
mission_objectives.intent: USA patrol aircraft / CAP encounter area.

real_world_anchor.label: Gulf of Tonkin CAP lane
real_world_anchor.doctrine: pull USA fighters off the carrier strike lane

mission_target_sets.title: Hanoi radar corridor package

target_elements.placement_hint: Place on or near the Hanoi radar waypoint; this is the runtime primary target slot.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Should cue SAM/AAA objects and be visible early enough for a SEAD pass.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place 1-3 nearby launcher objects offset from the radar so one bomb run cannot erase the whole site.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Threat should punish high-altitude direct ingress but leave low-altitude masking viable.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place around the radar perimeter or along the egress lane.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Short-range pressure only; avoid making the first sortie impossible.

mission_target_sets.editor_notes: Place paired radar/SAM/AAA objects around Hanoi; keep one clear low-altitude return lane to HQ.

mission_target_sets.title: Gulf of Tonkin carrier strike package
mission_target_sets.package_role: fighter sweep followed by anti-ship strike

target_elements.placement_hint: Place ahead of the carrier box, not directly on top of it, so sweep-first and bypass tactics differ.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Intercept player before anti-ship release; disengage pressure after carrier strike lane is opened.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place close to the carrier group as an escort/radar picket object.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Supports point defense and early warning; not required if using a simple one-object carrier target.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place at the Gulf of Tonkin carrier waypoint; this is the runtime primary target slot.
target_elements.defense_behavior: High-value target with escort coverage; should not require destroying every ship to complete the sortie.

mission_target_sets.editor_notes: Keep carrier and CAP separated enough that the player must choose sweep-first or high-risk direct strike.

mission_target_sets.title: Da Nang and Haiphong air-bridge package

target_elements.placement_hint: Place on the Haiphong logistics waypoint as a depot, bridge, port, or convoy-staging object.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Medium threat; should be optional if fuel or damage state makes Da Nang the safer priority.

target_elements.effect: stop USA sorties from Da Nang
target_elements.placement_hint: Place at the Da Nang waypoint; this is the runtime primary target slot.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Defended by local AAA/SAM and possible fighters, but reachable without carrier-level escort density.

target_elements.effect: increase recovery time after runway repair
target_elements.placement_hint: Place near but not overlapping the runway target so the player must choose a second pass.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Soft secondary target; useful for score/campaign effect rather than hard mission completion.

mission_target_sets.editor_notes: This route is long; keep threats sparse or provide a custom aircraft/fuel balance in future runtime logic.

notes: campaign.json is the modern custom-pack entry point for launchers and editor tools.
The WLD JSON remains the authoritative editable world/scenario data.
Aircraft visuals are campaign-local SVN/15FLT/shape_###_*.glb procedural placeholders unless disabled or overridden with --aircraft-glb.
Campaign-local PNGs are used before global replacements while this campaign is selected.
Campaign-local WAV cues are used before global cue replacements while this campaign is selected.
Font override entries document where to copy Cyrillic-capable TTF/OTF files; no font file is bundled by default.
Installed aircraft entries are copied into the campaign-local 15FLT shape slot directory and override shared aircraft only while the campaign is selected.
